text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: SEV-2 - serving-runtime errors (OOMs + container restarts) in eu-central-1 affecting model gpt-medium-v2. Alert triggered by elevated 500s and restart count > 15 in 10m. Pager: sara

sara: ack. i'm oncall. grabbing dashboard and logs now. can people avoid major changes in cluster until we stabilize?

nate: looking. HPA firing hard for this deployment, replicas jumping 3->28->5 over ~4m. CPU looks fine, GPU mem utilization spiking. kube events show multiple OOMKilled.

li: ```kubectl -n prod get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=gpt-medium-v2 | tail -n 30
2028-07-04T09:14:02Z Warning OOMKilled pod/gpt-medium-v2-7f9d8 Restarted container
2028-07-04T09:14:05Z Normal Scheduled pod/gpt-medium-v2-84a1 Node/instance-spot-3 scheduled
2028-07-04T09:14:20Z Warning Unhealthy kubelet pod probe failed```

omar: autoscaler logs: rapid scaling decisions from our HPA + Cluster Autoscaler due to short windows of high latency from a single tenant streaming loads. Cooldown settings appear to be default (30s), not enough for warmups.

maya: customer ops: seeing ~12% failures for a few tenants, highest for tenant-id acct-1192. starting customer notification draft.

sara: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) pause cluster-autoscaler scale-ups 2) set HPA max lower and min higher to avoid wide swings 3) reduce per-pod batch size and kv cache limits 4) cordon any nodes with recent driver errors

nate: prepared commands: ```# set HPA conservative bounds
kubectl patch hpa gpt-medium-v2 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6,"maxReplicas":12}}'
# pause cluster autoscaler
kubectl annotate deployment cluster-autoscaler pause=true --overwrite
# quick runtime config change
kubectl set env deployment/gpt-medium-v2 RUNTIME_MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=900 RUNTIME_KV_CACHE_MB=384```

li: I can apply the HPA patch and env change. someone else pause autoscaler?

sara: go ahead li, omar pause autoscaler. update here when done.

omar: paused autoscaler (annotated). verifying scaling events suppressed.

ops-bot: Action: HPA updated by li at 2028-07-04T09:18:20Z

li: env changes rolled out as a rolling update. canary 2 pods up with new runtime flags. logs show lower mem footprint so far.

nate: good. also seeing node flaps on spot instances: dmesg shows GPU driver panic Xid 79 and then kubelet marking NotReady. suspect mixed AMI/driver versions in spot pool.

sara: cordon the 3 most unstable nodes and drain. prefer scheduling to p4-highmem pool. apply node affinity to steer new pods.

omar: cordoned ip-10-2-11-101, ip-10-2-11-102, ip-10-2-11-103 and drained. patched deployment nodeSelector to prefer p4-highmem. rescheduling happening.

maya: customer-impact update: sent short notice to affected tenants with mitigations and that we're routing heavy tenants to fallback model (gpt-small-v2) for degraded quality but better reliability.

li: canary looks stable for 10m with zero OOMs. rolling restarts proceeding. overall restart rate dropped 65%.

sara: monitor for 30m then handoff. also create quick rollback plan if latency increases beyond threshold.

nate: observed side-effect: latency p95 increased ~120ms on p4 nodes due to different packing, keeping an eye. fallback routing for top 3 tenants enabled.

ops-bot: Route update: acct-1192 -> 70% gpt-small-v2 applied by maya at 2028-07-04T09:28:40Z

omar: logs: found repeated message on spot nodes: ```nvidia: kernel module mismatch: expected 540.1 got 535.xx - unloading``` not enough consistent driver on spot AMI. long-term fix: bake AMI with pinned driver, short-term: avoid spot pool for critical runtime.

li: applied taint to spot pool to prevent critical pods from scheduling there. will revert after AMI roll.

sara: great. start collecting crash dumps and perf traces for postmortem. please upload to s3://redwood-incidents/1845006789/artifacts and include heap profiles.

nate: uploading artifacts now. starting stackshots.

maya: customer ops: error rate down to ~3% after reroutes and runtime changes. customers acknowledged message.

sara: planning the handoff. nate, do you accept overnight watch? criteria: error rate >4% or new OOMs -> wakeup. also if autoscaler unpause is required, coordinate with oncall lead.

nate: accepted. will check dashboards every 30m and post updates.

ops-bot: Incident note appended by sara at 2028-07-04T09:41:12Z: Mitigation in progress, partial customer impact, handoff to nate.

li: next steps list: 1) bake golden AMI with locked NVIDIA driver (assign to eng-infra) 2) tune HPA cooldowns and add rate-limits on scale up 3) add runtime guards: fail open to smaller model if mem pressure high 4) add one-click pause autoscaler in console

sara: thanks team. I'll write initial incident brief and assign follow-ups. marking this chat as the live mitigation thread. please move postmortem discussion to the incident doc once mitigated. :white_check_mark:
